rules.sourceAuthority: inputs are editable sources; expected contains cached reference outputs, never additional input assumptions. Corporate finance links from borrowers; project finance uses entity projectEquityUSDm/projectDebtUSDm; origination values use entity originalAssetValueUSDm.
rules.numericGuard: typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value); null, undefined and empty string are not zero.
factorGate: activity, unit, scope, basis, source and version present
activityGate: unique activity ID and unique entity/site/scope/activity/year annual record
site belongs to same borrower and country, or siteId equals designated entity ID
Actual activity class only; estimates require an explicit further method
rules.activityTonnes: quantity * factor.kgCO2ePerUnit / 1000; no second GWP multiplication when factor is already CO2e
rules.inventorySelection: For each scope choose reported OR valid complete activity sum. Do not add the report to activity records. Require complete boundary, evidence, nonnegative finite amount, inventory/report year, expiry. S3 reported corporate/project method also requires relevant-category screening evidence. In this core implementation S3 Activity is unsupported.
rules.scope2InventoryBasis: Location-based or Market-based must be stated. Activity-derived S2 is Location-based only. Reported methods retain the reported basis.

Corporate private.dq: Verified report 1; unverified report 2; complete actual energy/process activity 2

Corporate listed.boundary: Borrower annual gross inventory; no cash deduction from EVIC
Corporate listed.dq: Verified report 1; unverified report 2; complete actual energy/process activity 2

Project finance.dq: Verified report 1; unverified report 2; complete actual energy/process activity 2

CRE.dq: Actual energy with average/grid factors 2; direct reported-total route not implemented

Mortgage.dq: Actual energy with average/grid factors 2; direct reported-total route not implemented

Motor.dq: Actual fuel/electricity consumption 1; other estimation routes not implemented

financeGate: financial/value date not after reporting date and evidenced
corporate listing matches method; private debt nonnegative
current financials match reporting year; corporate evidence unexpired
property/vehicle Origination or documented Fixed fallback basis, not current stressed collateral
facility borrower/entity/class match and designated-asset purpose for project/CRE/mortgage/motor
drawn amount finite/nonnegative and valid FX
aggregate bank drawn for one entity must not exceed its denominator in this implementation; surface review, do not cap silently
rules.attribution: drawnLocalm * fx.usdPerUnit / denominatorUSDm; exclude undrawn, CCF and stressed EAD. Multiply separately by available entity S1/S2/S3 annual tonnes.
rules.coverage: Covered USDm / all known drawn USDm for the filtered reporting population. S1+S2 joint coverage requires both scopes Ready. S3 separate. An unknown drawn amount makes the coverage ratio unavailable. Covered known subtotals must carry coverage; zero covered exposure means unavailable scope display, not zero emissions.
rules.quality: Exposure-weighted on the matching covered population. Scope DQ uses sum(drawn*scopeDQ)/sum(scope-covered drawn). Combined S1+S2 conservatively uses max(S1DQ,S2DQ) per facility then exposure weights; this is the module aggregation choice. Low score = stronger data, not lower risk or better ESG.
rules.jointHeadline: Sum financed S1+S2 only over facilities with method Ready AND S1 Ready AND S2 Ready. Customer, sector, country and portfolio screens must use this same population.
rules.overlap: Corporate and designated-asset boundaries for the same borrower can overlap; retain entity-level overlap review. Neither automatically remove nor silently claim a deduplicated physical footprint.

operations.control: One financial-control or operational-control basis. Unknown inclusion prevents completeness.
operations.scope1: diesel litres * valid combustion kgCO2e/litre / 1000 + separately reported other gross S1; require other-S1 evidence and whole-S1 boundary completeness. A missing other-S1 amount is not zero.
operations.dualTrigger: If any controlled operation has qualifying-market contractual information, calculate both LB and MB for all controlled operations. It is not triggered solely by buying certificates. Unknown applicability must remain unresolved.
operations.LB: electricity kWh * matching location grid kgCO2e/kWh / 1000
operations.MB: (qualified contract kWh * contract factor + remaining kWh * residual factor)/1000; if residual unavailable is explicitly No, use disclosed grid fallback; Unknown is unresolved when remainder exists.
operations.contractGate: 0 <= covered contract kWh <= consumption, quality review Pass, retirement evidence, matching country/year/unit/basis. Failed/pending criteria make MB unavailable rather than zero. If contract kWh=0 no contract factor/retirement is required.
operations.alternativeTotals: Show S1+S2-LB and S1+S2-MB separately; do not add LB and MB. MB/LB difference is an accounting-basis comparison, not automatically physical decarbonization.
operations.scopeLimit: Current detailed activity register covers electricity and diesel plus reported other S1. Add specific heat/steam/cooling methods and refrigerant-factor detail before claiming full energy-source functionality.

rules.scope3: All 15 categories remain visible. Included needs amount/method/evidence/year and boundary/overlap review. Excluded justified and Not applicable require rationale/evidence; Not assessed is unknown. Category 15 primary value links joint-covered financed S1+S2; investee S3 stays a distinct supplementary field. Other investment classes are unassessed, so full bank inventory remains partial.
